results.rationale: Consistency: wooden face, numbered markers, hands, black pedestal and gray setting persist, but the open C-shaped support becomes a complete surrounding ring. Instruction: the face widens somewhat, yet it remains elliptical with a thick visible right edge; the reference has a round frontal face and an open support, so the attempted front view has substantial orientation and occlusion errors. Quality: the clock rendering has coherent surfaces, readable numbers and convincing lighting.

Consistency: the white setting and metallic material persist, but the rectangular handle and original compact silhouette are replaced by a curved double-ended utensil. Instruction: recognizable conventional tines appear on one end, but the other end still has a fork-like slotted plate instead of a normal handle, so the unreasonable utensil is only poorly corrected. Quality: metal reflections are plausible, but the two conflicting ends form a conspicuously anomalous fork structure.
